cohort: The study included 1,086 patients admitted to intensive care with COVID-19 requiring mechanical ventilation (cases) and 10,860 population-based controls matched for age, sex, and district of residency.
finding: Type 2 diabetes, hypertension, obesity, and chronic kidney disease were all independently associated with severe COVID-19, with stronger associations found in younger populations, women, and non-EU immigrants for Type 2 diabetes.
